clips.title: The story
paras: Near Bloodhoof Village, Harb Clawhoof tends the tauren’s kodos. He offers them to worthy tauren riders and trusted champions of Thunder Bluff.

Harb Clawhoof tends the kodos near Bloodhoof Village. These great beasts carry heavy loads across long distances and are vital to tauren travel and work on the plains. Harb cares for each one, trains it, and pairs it with riders respected by the tauren people.

Tauren earn the trust needed to ride Harb’s kodos, while outsiders face closer scrutiny. Their size and temperament make kodos difficult for those unfamiliar with them to guide. Non-tauren allies must prove their loyalty and earn exalted standing with Thunder Bluff before riding one of Harb’s mounts.
